iraqi-browser-use.description: Iraqi-enhanced browser automation with cultural validation and Arabic RTL support

iraqi-browser-use-dev.description: Development version with debug logging enabled

usage: This configuration provides two MCP server endpoints:
1. iraqi-browser-use: Production server with minimal logging
2. iraqi-browser-use-dev: Development server with debug logging
• arabic_form_fill - Fill Arabic forms with RTL support
• cultural_validate - Validate content for Iraqi cultural appropriateness
• browser_navigate - Enhanced navigation with cultural validation
• browser_type - Type with Arabic RTL processing
• browser_get_state - Get page state with Arabic extraction
• browser_extract_content - Extract content with cultural filtering
• iraqi_agent_task - Execute complex Iraqi portal tasks
setup: 2. Install dependencies: pip install mcp browser-use langchain-openai
3. Add this config to Claude Desktop MCP settings
5. Test connection with: 'List available MCP tools'
cultural_features: • Automatic cultural validation for all Iraqi content
• Arabic RTL text processing with dialect preservation
• Iraqi government portal automation (ministries, courts, banks)
security_features: • Restricted to Iraqi domains for security
